title: DAY 3/90
MATHS
scenes.voice: Day three of the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge! One hundred and eight days to GATE. Maths marks are the easiest to secure, so let's lock them in.

scenes.title: Today's Topic
scenes.voice: Today's subject is Engineering Mathematics. Our topic: linear algebra.

scenes.title: Cover Today
scenes.voice: Cover matrix algebra, rank of a matrix, systems of linear equations, and eigenvalues with eigenvectors.

scenes.title: Quick Tip
scenes.voice: Quick tip. The sum of the eigenvalues equals the trace, their product equals the determinant, and rank plus nullity equals the number of columns.

scenes.title: Today's Plan
scenes.voice: Your free practice set with full solutions is on Telegram now. Today's test is open from seven to nine P. M. in our one rupee challenge course, and the toppers come in the next reel.
